# Inventory

Every operation the frontend calls, by the slice that defined it: 87 in all. A tick means the operation is in `openapi.yaml` with a request and response schema and at least one example captured from the mock. Where a handler and a slice prompt disagreed, see [DISCREPANCIES.md](DISCREPANCIES.md).

## Slice 1

- [x] `GET /api/me` — Who the caller is, and their application role. _(Any signed in user; 1 example)_

- [x] `GET /api/facilities/filter-options` — The values the browse filters offer, with counts across the whole catalogue. _(Any signed in user; 1 example)_

- [x] `GET /api/facilities/{id}` — One facility, with everything needed to decide whether it suits an event. _(Any signed in user; 2 examples)_

- [x] `GET /api/bookings` — The caller's own bookings, scoped by identity on the server. _(Roles: applicant, internal user; 1 example)_

- [x] `PUT /api/admin/facilities/{id}/approvers` — Replace who is designated to approve for the facility. _(Roles: facility administrator, system administrator; 1 example)_
